correctness.rationale: The complete general-q criterion follows by contracting runs of length 1 or 2 into a closed switching walk: the off-diagonal multigraph is nonempty and connected on active vertices, all degrees even, and loops h_ii do not exceed d_i/2. Conversely an Euler circuit has d_i/2 visits at vertex i, of which any h_ii may be doubled, proving all lengths including cyclic n=2. For q=3 the three cross-multiplicities have common parity eps and are uniquely x=2u+eps,y=2v+eps,t=2w+eps; the loop bounds give an exact positive generating sum. An independent symbolic common-denominator reduction recovered the stated z²P/[(1-z)^6(1+z)^3(1+z²)^2(1+z+z²)^2]. Nonzero factors at third/fourth roots enforce least period 12, with leading coefficient [5/96]/5!=1/2304. Enumeration of all ternary words through n=8 corroborated the analytic all-length proof.
